name: iwmp-shift-rostering
description: IWMP Manpower Rostering (IWMP-SCOPE-ROSTER-V01) — the Shift Rostering override screen for the iwmp tenant: roster board, crew view and week validation over the blueprint's eligibility engine. Self-contained: does NOT participate in the fams-v5-demo-environment pnpm workspace (same isolation route as tenants/uccp/overrides/screens/*), embedded in the host via <iframe>. Unlike the ported uccp screens it is NEW React 19 code and consumes the design system as linked `dist` exactly as the host app does — nothing is vendored and nothing in ../fams-design-system is modified.
